prose: Audit of cairn/devices/codemother/**/proofs on akienasus, 2026-11-13 (the orchestrator's pick, same as the tester audit that bore 4356/18cd): 30 candidates grepped for ~/.cairn, the live bus and this box's absolute paths, each run by bin/cairn test. 4 red, two shapes. (A) the seal helper in test_codemother.py and test_clearance.py asks reach("tester") to run a fixture by path; the session bus is akiendelllinux.local:7419, whose tester answers {"refused": "no proof file at '/home/akien/cairn/...'"}, so ['body']['record'] raises KeyError (6 teeth of test_codemother, test_clearance at import, and test_codemother_proofs_ride_the_published_scratch_bus, which runs test_codemother). (B) test_deposit_survives_a_move.py names a constrain berth at /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/ and globs that directory for its corpus tooth; akienasus has charted nothing, so the directory does not exist.
